setting.sl: Sobotno jutro v trgovini na kmetiji z ovcami herdwick v dolini. Na policah so sveža jajca, cumberlandska klobasa (svinjska klobasa, zvita v spiralo), marmelada iz slivic (damson) in med iz doline.
setting.de: Samstagmorgen im Hofladen eines Bauernhofs mit Herdwick-Schafen im Tal. In den Regalen liegen frische Eier, Cumberland-Würste (eine gewürzte Schweinswurst, zur Schnecke gerollt), Damson-Marmelade (aus kleinen Pflaumen) und Honig aus dem Tal.
setting.it: Sabato mattina allo spaccio di una fattoria con pecore Herdwick nella valle. Sugli scaffali ci sono uova fresche, salsiccia del Cumberland (una salsiccia di maiale speziata, arrotolata a spirale), marmellata di damson (piccole susine) e miele della valle.
setting.en: Saturday morning at the farm shop of a Herdwick sheep farm in the dale. On the shelves: fresh eggs, Cumberland sausage (a spiced pork sausage in a coil), damson jam and honey from the dale.

role: Mrs Atkinson, who runs the farm shop on her family's Herdwick farm in the dale. Friendly and chatty, proud of her eggs and her Cumberland sausage, calls customers "love". Simple, kind British English with a light Cumbrian touch.
speaker: woman
